title: ERBE Specification-First Acceptance V1

authority.execution_gate: independent ERBE runner and maintained tests

invariants: domain terminal predicates remain separate from Goal composite verdicts
environment errors are not semantic RED
RED and GREEN use the same frozen case identity
producer status is not independent validation evidence
builder_rule: Builder write scope excludes frozen contract, cases, expected values, RED evidence and claim ceiling; any revision requires Contract Patch, Scope Delta and re-RED.
non_goals: finite examples are not complete semantic law
readable BDD cards are not pass/fail authority
ERBE does not prove general semantic correctness or automatic human approval
